sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (White River NF 2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates)
Esri World Imagery z15/z17 with the catalog site coordinates

values.note: 21 sites plus a host site. FS: '40-foot maximum RV length'. Catalogued driveways run 17-83 ft; 02 (20 ft) and 06 (17 ft) are short; 03, 13 and 20 are pull-throughs. One RV with tow per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/little-maud-campground ('21 campsites plus a host site'; '40-foot maximum RV length') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('22/40'') + recreation.gov catalog 234776 (21 sites, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + notice 'One RV with tow per single site', read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/little-maud-campground ('No hook ups available') + recreation.gov 234776 ('electrical hook-ups are not available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Two flush toilets. Bear-proof food locker at each site; trash collection. Water may not be on before Memorial Day weekend or after September 30.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/little-maud-campground ('Flush Toilets (2)'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('If site has water, it may not be available prior to Memorial Day weekend due to cold temperatures or after September 30th') + recreation.gov 234776 (amenities Drinking Water, Flush Toilets, Trash Collection; 'Bear-proof food lockers are provided at each site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 2026 estimated dates; openings adjust for weather. Closed early in 2026 for lack of water.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (Little Maud CG '5/13-10/30'; 'These are estimated opening dates') + FS page Current Conditions ('Due to lack of water the campground is now closed for the 2026 season'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: All 21 sites reservable. Booking closes 2 days before arrival. 14 nights a year at most. A reservation is held until 11 am the day after arrival; occupy the site the first night. Extra vehicle paid at the campground. The 2027 and 2028 rate tables end Sep 29.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234776 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Each Year', reservationCutOff 2, weekend minimums 0; notices) + /rates (2026 Peak 05-13 to 10-29; 2027 and 2028 Peak 05-13 to 09-29) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('R'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: recreation.gov charges $32 a night; the FS page and 2026 operating sheet say $34, with weekday and weekend rates differing.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234776/rates (2026-2028 Peak STANDARD NONELECTRIC 32) + FS page ('Single Site: $34 per night') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('$34', 'Rates differ between weekdays/weekends'), read 2026-10-28

note: White River NF campground at ~7,800 ft on the slope above the north end of Ruedi Reservoir, off Frying Pan Road (CR 104) about 16 mi east of Basalt, sharing the Ruedi complex entrance with Little Mattie and Mollie B; boat ramp and picnic ground below, walk down to the water. --Claude
summary: FS page + 2026 operating sheet + recreation.gov: confirmed 21 sites, no electric, flush toilets, potable water, reservable. Added max 40 (FS), pull-through, season 05-13..10-30 (FS estimate), booking.season 05-13..10-29, 14-night max, 2-day cutoff; fees 32 -> 32-34 (FS $34). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: CLOSED: FS Current Conditions 'Due to lack of water the campground is now closed for the 2026 season' (page updated September 10, 2026). Water-system shortage, not reservoir level; no drawdown note on the page.

Missing phone: Aspen-Sopris Ranger District 970-963-2266 (White River NF; recreation.gov lists the district PO Box 309, Carbondale). recreation.gov's 801-226-3564 is the concessionaire's customer service line.
Operator: concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact Help.WhiteRiver.Sopris@AmericanLL.com, American Land & Leisure). Ownership federal stands.

Max length conflict: FS page '40-foot maximum RV length' and operating sheet '22/40'' vs the same FS page 'Twenty two sites are available for trailers under 32 ft.' vs recreation.gov 'maximum length of 35 feet for RVs'; catalog per-site 17-83 ft. Recorded 40. None of these is under 23 ft, so no rig-length criteria issue.
Site count: FS '21 campsites plus a host site' and recreation.gov 21 vs the operating sheet's 22 and 'Twenty two sites'. Kept 21.
Fee conflict: recreation.gov $32 (2026-2028) vs FS page and operating sheet $34. Recorded 32-34.
Toilets: recreation.gov description says vault toilets, but its amenity list and the FS page say flush (2). Kept flush.

Waterfront (stored lakeview) stands: on imagery the sites sit on a bench ~350-400 m from the full-pool shoreline of Ruedi's north cove, behind the boat-ramp lot; DEM 2,399 m vs full pool ~2,367 m (7,766 ft). recreation.gov: 'Sites at this campground open up to views of the reservoir'.
Pin 39.37667,-106.81389 is 42 m from the catalog site centroid. The FS coordinate 39.377671,-106.815919 is ~140 m west, on the entrance loop. OK.
